title: impatiens rupicola var. nataliae
intro: Impatiens rupicola var. nataliae, commonly known as Natal Balsam, is a flowering plant species in the balsam family. It is native to South Africa and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Natal Balsam include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
